import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Filter the relevant columns for documentation methods
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Convert the relevant columns to numeric values
for col in documentation_columns:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=documentation_columns)

# Calculate the frequency of each documentation method
documentation_freq = df[documentation_columns].sum()

# Bootstrap the frequency distribution
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((documentation_freq,), statistic='mean', confidence_level=0.95)

# Display the results
documentation_freq, bootstrap_result

import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Define the documentation columns
documentation_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others'
]

# Convert the documentation columns to binary (1 for 'quoted', 0 for 'not quoted')
for col in documentation_columns:
    df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == 'quoted' else 0)

# Drop rows with missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=documentation_columns)

# Calculate the frequency of each documentation method
documentation_freq = df[documentation_columns].sum()

# Display the results
documentation_freq
